description: Verify that the Interface Version of the notification is 0x01
approach:
[Objective]
This case asserts a single SOME/IP-SD wire-format invariant: Interface Version must equal 0x01. The harness drives DUT to emit a qualifying notification, captures it, and validates the field byte-precisely.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester drives DUT to emit a notification (typically by completing OfferService prelude or sending a stimulus message).
2. Observation: captured notification's Interface Version == 0x01   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Interface Version on the wire equals 0x01.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_interface_version — Interface version not 0x01
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying notification within the listen window

verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying notification within listen window
